viewing_reliability.vs_oracle_a: Cutter E is more reliable in actual viewing: correct AU/take use, complete result/CTA chains, and no low-level loops. Oracle A remains closer on a few exact human boundaries and GT010 hold imitation.
viewing_reliability.vs_test_b: Cutter E is decisively more reliable: Test B's 8-11s, 18-21s and CTA-tail visible loops are absent.

core_verdict.next_step: Because viewing is materially better, discuss promoting only the verified candidate constraint and executable sanity gate; do not write main in this run.
